title: rubus arenarius
intro: Rubus arenarius, commonly known as the Arctic bramble or sea bramble, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). The health benefits of Rubus arenarius include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a diuretic, astringent, and demulcent, making it useful for treating urinary issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rubus arenarius include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activity.
